title: Biden says he'll shut down Nord Stream 2 pipeline if Russia further invades Ukraine
summary: A one-minute Yahoo Finance clip of President Biden saying he would shut down the Nord Stream 2 pipeline if Russia further invaded Ukraine.
why: HN commenters cite it as evidence in arguments over who was behind the Nord Stream sabotage, quoting Biden's statement.

quote.text: there will be no longer a North Stream 2, we will bring an end to it
